context: Refactors the Express error-handling middleware. This is the final catch-all middleware registered on the app.
explanation: Removing the logger means 500-class errors vanish silently — the client gets a generic message but the server has no record of what went wrong. In production, unlogged errors are invisible and undebuggable. Fix: keep logging the error details (method, url, message, stack) for every non-client error.
